items.title: James Cook: Heads to medical tent Sunday
items.text:
Cook (undisclosed) headed to the blue medical tent during Sunday's game against the Ravens after absorbing a hard hit, Matt Parrino reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: James Cook: Cleared to return Sunday
